Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from this section's selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge or memory.
The nitrous oxide paragraph begins on the previous page; its penalties and warning are taught from the first selected page, where they are printed [A01].
The minimum jail term for a second or later extreme DUI is missing its number in the extracted text, so no jail minimum is taught for that tier (verify AZ-DUI-D-EXTREMEJAIL) [A02].
The list of cases eligible for a Special Ignition Interlock Restricted Driver License on the last selected page mixes day-one and ninety-day items with date cutoffs that appear inconsistent; only the general day-one rule is taught (verify AZ-DUI-D-INTERLOCKLIST) [A03].
The aggravated DUI requirements and the Executive Hearing Office paragraph both run across page breaks; each statement is taught from the page where it is printed, and the appeal notice details on the next page are not taught [A03].
Originality: every statement is reworded from the cited page; no manual sentence, table, image or official test question is reproduced.
Exam numbers: the manual prints no question count, passing score, item format or time limit, so none is stated anywhere in this section; the typed debts live in part A.
External review: restating published Arizona traffic and licensing rules needs no clinical or legal sign-off; none is requested.
